name: pstack-resident
description: Opt-in resident mode for pstack-zcode: a SessionStart hook that injects the condensed poteto-mode summary into sessions of projects where poteto-mode is installed. Installing this plugin is the whole opt-in; sessions in other projects get nothing.

description_i18n.zh-CN: pstack-zcode 的常驻模式（可选）：SessionStart 钩子向装有 poteto-mode 的项目的会话注入精简纪律摘要。安装本插件即完成 opt-in；其他项目的会话零注入。
